slides.heading: pov reality of building a saas in 2026

cutout.note: young man in a hoodie on the floor with a laptop on a cardboard box, pizza box, dead tired stare

slides.heading: the game has changed
body:
a few years back, building was the hard part.
if you could ship an app, you were ahead.

now ai writes the code.
anyone can launch the same thing in a weekend.

the edge moved. it's not the app anymore.
it's who actually sees it.

cutout.note: older man in a tweed blazer lowering a newspaper in shock

slides.heading: distribution is the game
body:
i break down tiktoks that blow up.
one was a single selfie with one question
on it. 17.4 million views.
no editing. no face cam. no budget.

simple slideshows are getting millions
of views while polished apps launch
to nobody.

cutout.note: man in suspenders jabbing a finger at printed bar charts, excited grin

slides.heading: flip the order
body:
the usual move is months of coding,
a launch, then panic about marketing.
flip it. post from day one.

i used Amplify to turn formats that
work on TikTok into posts for my saas.
30 posts. didn't pay for any of them.
(link in bio)

cutout.note: young woman curled in an armchair with a laptop and popcorn, smirking

slides.heading: post twice a day
body:
one post a week feels productive.
it's not. it's a lottery ticket.

batch your posts once a week
and schedule two a day on TikTok.

volume is how you find out
what your audience actually wants.

cutout.note: coach in a tracksuit holding up two fingers and a stopwatch, shouting

slides.heading: double down
body:
after two weeks you'll have real data.
most formats will flop. that's normal.

kill the ones that flop.
take the one that hit and make ten more.
that's where growth starts compounding.

cutout.note: man in a loosened tuxedo pushing two stacks of poker chips forward

slides.heading: conclusion
body: yes, everyone's shipping now.

but if you post every day
and keep only what works,
you'll pass most of them.

no team. no ad budget.
just posts, every day.
Amplify is the link in my bio.

cutout.note: young woman in a denim jacket on the edge of a desk with a mug, calm smile
